test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

We thought / there was a good idea / to wear snow boots / before we stepped out.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. there was a good idea .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**there was a good idea**" is grammatically incorrect because it misuses "there was." The correct phrase should be "**it was a good idea**" as the sentence refers to a specific idea (to wear snow boots).
 
• "There was" is typically used to indicate the existence of something, not to describe or evaluate it.

Correct sentence: *We thought **it was a good idea** to wear snow boots before we stepped out*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The error lies in the use of "there was" instead of "it was." This is a common mistake when describing an idea or opinion.
 
• When expressing opinions or evaluations, "it was" is more appropriate than "there was."
